entries.text: Edit proposed wording in either review layout, make or reset individual and bulk decisions, then apply accepted changes as one revision. Applying an all-rejected review dismisses it without changing the Article, and accepted changes return you to Write.
Assistant proposals no longer repeat the Article title as body text.

When a selection request needs Article text, the Assistant can use up to 500 code units of read-only text on each side of the selection. The composer explains that this neighboring text is sent to your provider, and only the selection can be replaced.
See your message in the Assistant conversation while a request is being prepared.
New guides explain the built-in Skills and how to use and review their results.
Update details appear alongside update actions in Settings, and the Article Library update control is aligned in expanded and collapsed views.
